description: We’re a family team: Eldrich (11) does Arduino wiring, coding and testing, Hailey (10) leads sound design, story and the cardboard build, and Valentinus (parent) supervises safety and handles the submission. We built Earth Jukebox, a hardware + software project that turns NASA ocean temperature data into sound, vibration, light and a robot hand, so people who can’t see or can’t hear can explore it too. Our team is complete.
